Hi Marta / ops team — quick technical notes ahead of the handoff meeting (copying Vivek for implementation detail):

Planned seeding approach (sandbox):
- Create a Redwood project named brightbridge-sandbox-2026.
- Seed two service keys: sb-integ-key (rotates every 30d), sb-ingest-key (rotates every 90d by default).
- Create an admin user role (Admin) and a limited operator role (IngestOperator) with scoped token permissions.

Options for delivery:
1) Console invite: we invite m.lopez@ and aaron.kim@ as admins. Service keys are generated in-console and can be downloaded once.
2) CSV import: we send a csv (attached) with service key metadata if you prefer to import into your vault.

Rotation / KMS notes:
- We support KMS-wrapped key uploads. If you want Redwood to never store plaintext, provide a public wrapping key and we will store the wrapped blob.
- For automated rotation, we can configure webhook triggers to notify your ops when a key is rotated; we don't push rotated keys into external KMS automatically unless you provide the integration.

Attaching the small csv template for the import and a concise rotation FAQ. Will cover these in the 11am call.

Thanks — Ben
